meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行发起多路审查，把关已完成工作质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在交接已完工作前需要多路审查把关。
copy.tagline_en: Launch parallel review agents to validate completed work before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need parallel review agents to check your completed work before handoff.

howto.what: 调用后，Claude 会并行启动 5 个后台子代理，检查目标是否达成、代码质量、安全性，并实际运行应用、从 GitHub/git/Slack/Notion 收集背景。五个全部通过，审查才通过。
howto.when: 当用户要求审查已完成的工作，例如说出“check my work”、“verify implementation”等时；在提交 PR（pull request）前也应当主动使用。

say.note: 会并行启动 5 个子代理审查。
适合在提交 PR 前要求检查时使用。
会核对需求是否全部达成。

howto.what_en: Launches 5 parallel sub-agents to review completed work: goal/constraint verification, code quality, security, hands-on QA by running the app, and context mining. The review passes only if all five pass.
howto.when_en: Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers include 'review my work', 'check my work', 'verify implementation', etc.

say_en.note: Handy right before submitting a PR.
Checks whether all requirements were met.
